items.title: Micropolis Receives NYSE American Extension to File Delayed Annual Report
items.summary: Micropolis AI Robotics has been granted an extension by NYSE Regulation to file its delayed 2025 Form 20-F annual report by December 13, 2026.
items.content: Micropolis AI Robotics (NYSE American: MCRP) announced that it received approval from NYSE Regulation for an extension to regain compliance with continued listing standards. The company, which failed to file its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, by the original May 15, 2026 deadline, has been granted a new cure period ending December 13, 2026. The extension follows the expiration of an initial six-month cure period on November 15, 2026. While the company is working with auditors to complete the filing, it noted there is no assurance that it will meet the new deadline or ultimately regain full compliance. NYSE Regulation will monitor the company's progress during this period and may initiate delisting proceedings if milestones are not met.

items.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard Reports Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Results and Provides Update on Żabka Tender Offer
items.summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard reported its fiscal second-quarter results for 2027 and announced that its tender offer for Żabka Group has become unconditional following regulatory approvals.
items.content: Alimentation Couche-Tard reported a profit of $691.3 million, or 75 cents per share, for the second quarter ended October 11, 2026, compared to $740.6 million, or 79 cents per share, in the same period last year. Adjusted earnings were 84 cents per share, exceeding analyst expectations of 80 cents. Revenue rose to $22.54 billion from $17.87 billion, driven by higher fuel selling prices. CEO Alex Miller noted improved performance in the U.S. business, including sequential increases in same-store sales and merchandise margin expansion. items.title: Baozun Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Baozun Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting total net revenues of RMB 2,386.4 million, a 10.7% increase year-over-year.
items.content: Baozun Inc. reported total net revenues of RMB 2,386.4 million (US$355.9 million) for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 10.7% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company recorded a loss from operations of RMB 51.1 million, compared to a loss of RMB 25.6 million in the prior-year period, while the non-GAAP loss from operations was RMB 40.7 million. Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders narrowed to RMB 55.7 million from RMB 107.1 million in the third quarter of 2025. Management highlighted that the Brand Management segment's non-GAAP operating loss narrowed to RMB 28 million, driven by improved profitability for the Gap brand, which remains on track for full-year breakeven in 2026. Additionally, the company disclosed that as of November 24, 2026, it had US$9.1 million remaining under its current share repurchase program.

items.title: Click Holdings Limited Board Approves Share Repurchase Program of Up to US$1.5 Million
items.summary: Click Holdings Limited announced that its board of directors has authorized a share repurchase program to buy back up to US$1.5 million of its Class A ordinary shares.
items.content: Click Holdings Limited has authorized a share repurchase program allowing the company to buy back up to US$1.5 million of its Class A ordinary shares. The board's decision is based on the belief that the current market price of the company's shares does not adequately reflect its financial performance and long-term prospects. The program will be funded from available cash on hand and may be executed through open-market purchases or privately negotiated transactions in compliance with Rule 10b-18. The authorization is valid for a period of up to 12 months. The company noted that its shares were recently valued at approximately US$0.66 per share, implying a market capitalization of about US$5.7 million.

items.title: INNEOVA Holdings Limited to Effect 1-for-5 Share Consolidation
items.summary: INNEOVA Holdings Limited announced a 5-for-1 share consolidation, effective November 27, 2026, to maintain compliance with Nasdaq listing requirements.
items.content: INNEOVA Holdings Limited announced that its shareholders approved a 5-for-1 share consolidation at the annual general meeting held on September 3, 2026. The consolidation is scheduled to become effective on the Nasdaq Capital Market on November 27, 2026. This action is intended to ensure the company maintains compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2). Following the consolidation, the company's issued and outstanding ordinary shares will be reduced from 16,770,624 to approximately 3,354,125, and the shares will trade under a new CUSIP number, G7776G112, while retaining the ticker symbol 'INEO'.

items.title: Noah Holdings Hosts 19th Global Black Diamond Summit in Singapore
items.summary: Noah Holdings Limited successfully hosted its 19th Global Black Diamond Summit, titled 'The Anchorage,' focusing on global asset allocation and wealth management in the AI era.
items.content: Noah Holdings Limited hosted its 19th Global Black Diamond Summit, 'The Anchorage,' in Singapore, where the company is headquartered. The event gathered hundreds of clients, global asset management representatives, and leaders from business, government, and academia to discuss long-term investment strategies, asset allocation, and family wealth arrangements. Under the theme 'Safe Passage, Wider Horizons,' the summit addressed the challenges of market volatility and the impact of AI on investment decision-making. Keynote speakers, including Co-Founder and Chairwoman Norah Wang, emphasized the importance of balancing growth and protection for high-net-worth families in the current economic environment.

items.title: Noah Holdings Limited Announces Unaudited Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026
items.summary: Noah Holdings Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, detailing net income and client metrics.
items.content: Noah Holdings Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026. The company reported net income attributable to shareholders of RMB97.4 million (US$14.5 million), representing a 55.4% decrease compared to the same period in 2025. Non-GAAP net income attributable to shareholders was RMB101.0 million (US$15.1 million), a 55.9% decrease year-over-year. The company noted that net revenues were impacted by lower performance-based income from mainland China public securities and asset management products. As of September 30, 2026, the company had 470,522 registered clients, while the aggregate value of investment products distributed during the quarter reached RMB16.0 billion (US$2.4 billion).

items.title: Youxin Technology Ltd Announces 1-for-6 Share Consolidation
items.summary: Youxin Technology Ltd has announced that its shareholders approved a 1-for-6 share consolidation of its Class A ordinary shares, effective November 27, 2026.
items.content: Youxin Technology Ltd (Nasdaq: YAAS) announced that its shareholders have approved a 1-for-6 share consolidation of the company's Class A ordinary shares. The consolidation is scheduled to become effective on November 27, 2026, with the goal of increasing the per-share trading price and supporting the company's continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. Following the consolidation, the number of issued and outstanding Class A ordinary shares is expected to decrease from approximately 6.77 million to approximately 1.13 million. The company's Class B ordinary shares remain unaffected by this action, and the ticker symbol 'YAAS' will be retained.

items.title: Zhihu Inc. Reports Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Zhihu Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting total revenues of RMB658.6 million and a net loss of RMB48.6 million.
items.content: Zhihu Inc. reported total revenues of RMB658.6 million for the third quarter of 2026, remaining flat compared to the same period in 2025. The company recorded a net loss of RMB48.6 million, compared to RMB46.7 million in the prior year, with an adjusted net loss of RMB30.8 million. Marketing services revenue grew 4.5% year-over-year to RMB198.0 million, while total operating expenses declined by 3.1% to RMB487.8 million. As of September 30, 2026, the company held cash and equivalents, term deposits, restricted cash, and short-term investments totaling RMB4,240.4 million. Additionally, the company repurchased 6.7 million Class A ordinary shares for US$7.3 million during the quarter.

items.title: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target for Zoom Communications
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for Zoom Communications, Inc. while maintaining an Equal Weight rating.
items.content: Morgan Stanley updated its outlook on Zoom Communications, Inc. by raising the price target from $107 to $108. The firm maintained its Equal Weight rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects the firm's ongoing analysis of the company's market performance and growth prospects.

items.title: YYForce Launches 'Six Seven' Humanoid Concierge Robot
items.summary: YYForce Inc. has introduced a proprietary-trained humanoid robot, named 'Six Seven', designed for hospitality concierge services at Novotel Singapore on Stevens.
items.content: YYForce Inc. announced the launch of its first humanoid concierge robot, 'Six Seven' (67), which is being deployed at the Novotel Singapore on Stevens. The robot utilizes NVIDIA Jetson edge AI computing and NVIDIA Isaac Sim simulation workflows to provide real-time guest assistance, including information on dining, hotel amenities, and local travel guidance. This deployment marks a transition for the company in applying commercial embodied AI within guest-facing hospitality environments. The robot is designed to handle open-ended guest inquiries and interactive storytelling to enhance the arrival experience.

items.title: S&P Global Ratings Revises Outlook for Studio City Company Limited to Negative
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has revised the rating outlook for Studio City Company Limited from stable to negative, while maintaining its 'B+' long-term issuer credit rating.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, S&P Global Ratings adjusted the outlook for Studio City Company Limited and its parent-related entity, Melco Resorts (Macau) Limited, to negative from stable. The agency maintained the 'B+' long-term issuer credit rating for Studio City Company Limited. This action reflects expectations of a softer gaming environment in Macau over the next 12 months, which may increase uncertainty regarding the group's deleveraging path. S&P noted that weaker consumer confidence and stricter capital controls have impacted gaming revenue, with the group's consolidated debt leverage rising to 5.8x as of September 30, 2026. The agency anticipates that a challenging industry environment may continue to pressure EBITDA recovery in the near term.

items.title: ChipMOS to Present at Cathay Securities 2026 Q4 Industry Forum
items.summary: ChipMOS Technologies Inc. announced that it will present to institutional investors at the Cathay Securities 2026 Q4 Industry Forum on December 3, 2026.
items.content: ChipMOS Technologies Inc. will participate in the Cathay Securities 2026 Q4 Industry Forum, scheduled to take place at the Grand Hyatt Taipei on December 3, 2026. Management, including Jesse Huang, Senior Vice President of Strategy and Investor Relations, is set to discuss the company's recent financial results, business trends, and growth opportunities. This presentation serves as an opportunity for the company to engage with institutional investors regarding its current market position and strategic outlook.

items.title: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. Regains Compliance with Nasdaq Minimum Bid Price Requirement
items.summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd. announced it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, GCL Global Holdings Ltd. announced that it received a written notice from the Listing Qualifications Department of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC on November 23, 2026. The notice confirmed that the company has regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). This compliance was achieved after the company's ordinary shares maintained a closing bid price of $1.00 or greater for 10 consecutive business days, from November 6 to November 20, 2026. The resolution of this deficiency removes the risk of delisting from the Nasdaq Capital Market related to the bid price rule.

items.title: Haoxi Health Technology Limited Experiences Trading Halt
items.summary: Haoxi Health Technology Limited (NASDAQ: HAO) was subject to a volatility-related trading halt on November 24, 2026.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Haoxi Health Technology Limited (NASDAQ: HAO) experienced a trading halt due to a volatility trading pause. The halt was implemented during the trading session to manage market volatility associated with the company's Class A ordinary shares. Such pauses are standard market mechanisms designed to maintain orderly trading conditions.

items.title: BingEx Limited Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: BingEx Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, reporting revenue of RMB 929.4 million and a net loss of RMB 6.8 million.
items.content: BingEx Limited (Nasdaq: FLX) reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB 929.4 million (US$ 138.6 million), a decrease from RMB 1,005.4 million in the same period of 2025, which the company attributed to intensifying market competition. Gross profit for the quarter was RMB 104.5 million (US$ 15.6 million), compared to RMB 111.8 million in the prior year period. The company recorded a net loss of RMB 6.8 million (US$ 1.0 million), contrasting with a net income of RMB 43.7 million in the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP net loss was RMB 1.0 million (US$ 0.2 million), compared to a non-GAAP net income of RMB 62.6 million in the same period of 2025. Total orders fulfilled reached 62.8 million. Additionally, as of November 23, 2026, the company had repurchased approximately 4.9 million ADSs for US$ 13.3 million under its US$ 30.0 million share repurchase program.

items.title: Abits Group Signs Letter of Intent to Acquire Soter Technologies
items.summary: Abits Group announced a nonbinding letter of intent to acquire Soter Technologies, a provider of environmental sensing and AI-enabled monitoring software.
items.content: Abits Group has signed a nonbinding letter of intent to acquire Soter Technologies, Inc., a company specializing in environmental sensing technology and AI-enabled monitoring software. The acquisition is intended to support Abits' strategy of developing integrated digital infrastructure by adding technology that helps data center operators predict and identify potential equipment issues. Abits plans to retain Soter's senior management team, subject to final agreements. The transaction remains subject to due diligence, negotiation of definitive agreements, and other customary closing conditions.

items.title: CDT Environmental Technology Reports Unaudited Financial Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026
items.summary: CDT Environmental Technology announced its unaudited interim financial results for the first half of 2026, reporting $7.22 million in revenue and a net loss of $1.28 million.
items.content: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Limited reported total revenues of $7.22 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, a slight decrease from $7.32 million in the same period of 2025. The company's consolidated net loss improved to $1.28 million from $1.31 million in the first half of 2025. Working capital strengthened to approximately $31.66 million as of June 30, 2026, compared to $26.41 million at the end of 2025. Additionally, the company noted that it successfully closed a direct offering of 2,480,000 Class A ordinary shares in April 2026, generating net proceeds of $6.26 million. Management also indicated that the company is currently awaiting results for two new sewage treatment project bids, which are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

items.title: S&P Global Ratings Revises Outlook for Melco Resorts (Macau) and Studio City to Negative
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has adjusted the rating outlook for Melco Resorts (Macau) Ltd. and Studio City Company Limited from "stable" to "negative," citing concerns over the Macau gaming industry's outlook.
items.content: S&P Global Ratings has revised the rating outlook for Melco Resorts (Macau) Ltd. and Studio City Company Limited to "negative" from "stable," while maintaining their respective long-term issuer credit ratings of "BB-" and "B+." The agency attributed this change to a weakening outlook for the Macau gaming sector over the next 12 months, noting that softer consumer confidence and stricter capital controls are impacting gaming revenue. S&P observed that the group's debt leverage has risen higher than previously forecast, reaching 5.8 times as of September 30, 2026. The agency indicated that the outlook could return to "stable" if the company successfully executes its deleveraging plan and maintains leverage below 5 times.

items.title: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd. Appoints Zhigang (Sam) Yang as Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd. announced the appointment of Mr. Zhigang (Sam) Yang as its new Chief Financial Officer, effective November 20, 2026.
items.content: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd. has appointed Mr. Zhigang (Sam) Yang as its Chief Financial Officer, effective November 20, 2026. In this role, Mr. Yang will oversee the company's finance, strategy, investment, and financing functions. The company stated that this appointment is intended to strengthen its management team as it expands its global footprint and enters its next stage of growth.

items.title: ICZOOM Group Inc. Receives Nasdaq Notification Regarding Delinquent Annual Report
items.summary: ICZOOM Group Inc. announced it received a notification from Nasdaq regarding its failure to timely file its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026.
items.content: On November 20, 2026, ICZOOM Group Inc. received a written notification from the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC stating that the company is not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to its failure to file its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The notification has no immediate effect on the listing or trading of the company's securities. The company is required to submit an update to its previously submitted plan to regain compliance by December 7, 2026. Management stated it is working to complete the required financial reporting and remains committed to maintaining compliance with Nasdaq listing standards.

items.title: The GrowHub Announces Two Subsidiaries as Recipients of the Singapore SME 500 Award 2026
items.summary: The GrowHub Limited announced that its subsidiaries, The GrowHub Innovations Company Pte. Ltd. and GrowHub Carbon Pte. Ltd., have been honored with the Singapore SME 500 Award 2026.
items.content: The GrowHub Limited reported that two of its Singapore-based subsidiaries, The GrowHub Innovations Company Pte. Ltd. and GrowHub Carbon Pte. Ltd., received the Singapore SME 500 Award 2026. This recognition marks the fourth consecutive year that The GrowHub Innovations Company has been selected for the award. The company stated that the achievement reflects its ongoing presence and standing within the Singapore business community. The GrowHub continues to focus on its core operations in sustainability, carbon solutions, and technology-enabled services across the Asia-Pacific region and Europe.

items.title: Analog Devices Reports Record Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Analog Devices announced record financial results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026, driven by growth in data center and industrial markets.
items.content: Analog Devices, Inc. reported record performance for fiscal year 2026, with annual revenue reaching $15.2 billion, a 38% increase over the previous year. Fourth-quarter revenue rose 42% year-over-year to $4.37 billion, supported by strong demand in the data center, industrial, and communications segments. The company generated $6.2 billion in operating cash flow and $5.5 billion in free cash flow for the fiscal year, returning $5.4 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases. Additionally, the board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.10 per share, payable on December 21, 2026. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company provided revenue guidance of $4.4 billion, plus or minus $150 million, with an adjusted EPS forecast of $3.82, plus or minus $0.20.

items.title: Lockheed Martin CEO and CFO to Participate in UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference
items.summary: Lockheed Martin announced that Chairman, President and CEO Jim Taiclet and CFO Evan Scott will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference.
items.content: Lockheed Martin Chairman, President and CEO Jim Taiclet and CFO Evan Scott are scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference. The event will take place on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 10:30 a.m. to 11:10 a.m. ET. A live webcast of the discussion will be accessible through the company's investor events portal, with a replay available for two weeks following the presentation.

items.title: Nasdaq Announces Delisting of Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. 6% Convertible Preferred Stock
items.summary: Nasdaq has formally announced the delisting of the 6% Convertible Preferred Stock of Bio Green Med Solution, Inc., which had been suspended from trading since March 2026.
items.content: On November 23, 2026, Nasdaq announced the delisting of the 6% Convertible Preferred Stock of Bio Green Med Solution, Inc. The securities had been suspended from trading on the exchange since March 23, 2026. This action is part of a broader series of delisting announcements by the exchange for various securities that have remained suspended for extended periods.

items.title: Ongoing Legal Developments in Depo-Provera Meningioma Litigation
items.summary: Depositions are currently underway involving Pfizer's pharmacovigilance department regarding the company's monitoring and communication of potential safety risks associated with Depo-Provera.
items.content: Legal proceedings are continuing regarding the potential association between the use of the contraceptive Depo-Provera and the development of meningioma tumors. Depositions are currently being conducted with safety professionals within Pfizer's pharmacovigilance department to examine the company's internal processes for identifying and evaluating safety signals reported in medical literature. The litigation focuses on the company's responsibilities for monitoring and communicating safety risks to the public and medical community. These developments follow reports of clinical cases involving patients with a history of long-term Depo-Provera exposure.

items.title: Huadi International Group Co., Ltd. Announces 1-for-8 Reverse Stock Split
items.summary: Huadi International Group Co., Ltd. is implementing a 1-for-8 reverse stock split of its ordinary shares, effective November 27, 2026.
items.content: Huadi International Group Co., Ltd. announced that it will implement a reverse stock split of all issued and unissued ordinary shares at an exchange ratio of one share for every eight shares. The reverse stock split was approved by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting held on November 16, 2026. Following the split, the company's ordinary shares will commence trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on a post-split basis starting November 27, 2026. The action will reduce the number of outstanding ordinary shares from approximately 14,319,182 to approximately 1,789,898.

items.title: Genius Group Announces $2 Million Expansion of Genius School in Bali
items.summary: Genius Group Limited has announced a $2 million expansion of its AI-powered Genius School in Bali, Indonesia, following record student enrolments in October 2026.
items.content: The expansion plan, approved by the board, aims to increase student capacity and enhance campus facilities, including the addition of a new future lab, athletics center, and community hub at the flagship Nuanu Campus. The company targets 800 students by the end of 2027, representing a 60% increase from current levels, and projects $14.9 million in revenue from the school by 2029. This initiative is part of the company's broader strategy to establish Genius School as a leading future-focused educational institution in Asia.

items.title: Amber International Holding Limited to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Amber International Holding Limited announced it will release its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on December 1, 2026.
items.content: Amber International Holding Limited (Nasdaq: AMBR) has scheduled the release of its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, for before the U.S. market opens on Tuesday, December 1, 2026. Following the release, the company's management team will host an earnings conference call at 8:00 AM U.S. Eastern Time to discuss the results and provide a business update. A replay of the call will be available from December 1, 2026, through December 15, 2026.

items.title: Kingsoft Cloud Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, reporting a 40.4% year-over-year increase in total revenue to RMB 3,478.1 million.
items.content: Kingsoft Cloud reported total revenue of RMB 3,478.1 million for the third quarter of 2026, representing a 40.4% year-over-year increase. Public cloud revenue grew by 57.3% year-over-year to RMB 2,756.7 million, significantly bolstered by AI cloud gross billings which reached RMB 1,683 million, a 115% increase compared to the same period in 2025. The company achieved an adjusted gross margin of 15.7% and a record adjusted operating profit margin of 4.4%. Despite the revenue growth, the company reported a net loss of RMB 118.1 million, compared to a net loss of RMB 7.8 million in the third quarter of 2025. Management indicated a strategic focus on intelligent computing, agentic AI, and inference platforms to drive future growth.

items.title: MobilityOne Secures Interim Stay Against Winding-Up Petition
items.summary: MobilityOne Limited has obtained an interim stay order against a winding-up petition filed by a merchant against its Malaysian subsidiary, MobilityOne Sdn Bhd.
items.content: MobilityOne Limited announced that its wholly-owned Malaysian subsidiary, MobilityOne Sdn Bhd (M1 Malaysia), secured an interim stay order from the High Court of Malaya on 20 November 2026. The stay halts a winding-up petition initiated by Glam Legacy Sdn Bhd, an e-commerce merchant, regarding a payment dispute of approximately RM3,378,444 (c. £0.6 million). MobilityOne stated that the funds were withheld for reasons unrelated to its financial position and that it possesses the cash resources to settle the obligation. The court order provides a mechanism for M1 Malaysia to release the disputed funds to the merchant's solicitors throughout November and December 2026. The company expects to apply for the formal termination of the winding-up petition on or before 31 December 2026.

items.title: CytoMed Therapeutics Appoints Dr. Ahmad Radzi bin Ahmad Badruddin as Independent Director
items.summary: CytoMed Therapeutics Limited has appointed veteran oncologist Dr. Ahmad Radzi bin Ahmad Badruddin to its Board of Directors and its Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.
items.content: CytoMed Therapeutics Limited announced the appointment of Dr. Ahmad Radzi bin Ahmad Badruddin as an Independent Director and a member of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, effective November 24, 2026. Dr. Radzi is a clinical oncologist with over 30 years of experience in cancer treatment, clinical research, and healthcare leadership. He previously served on the company's Scientific Advisory Board. The company stated that his appointment brings scientific expertise and industry experience to the Board, which has determined that he meets the independence requirements under Nasdaq Listing Rules.

items.title: Qfin Holdings, Inc. Announces Unaudited Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026
items.summary: Qfin Holdings, Inc. reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided a financial outlook for the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.content: Qfin Holdings, Inc. announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total net revenue of RMB 3,088.5 million and net income of RMB 380.5 million. As of September 30, 2026, the platform had connected 168 financial institutional partners and 305.2 million consumers. For the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects to generate a net income between RMB 210 million and RMB 310 million, representing a year-on-year decline of 67% to 77%.

items.title: Maverick Medical AI Integrates CodeAgent with Microsoft Dragon Copilot
items.summary: Maverick Medical AI is showcasing its CodeAgent documentation assistant within Microsoft's Dragon Copilot at RSNA 2026.
items.content: Maverick Medical AI announced the integration of its real-time AI documentation assistant, CodeAgent, into Microsoft Dragon Copilot, a radiology reporting solution. The integration is designed to work alongside PowerScribe One, a platform used by numerous healthcare organizations in the United States. By surfacing clinical-to-revenue intelligence directly within the reporting workflow, the offering aims to reduce physician rework and accelerate reimbursement processes. The solution will be showcased at the RSNA 2026 conference.

items.title: Microsoft Declares 'Code Red' Following Historic Outage
items.summary: Microsoft has initiated a 'Code Red' mobilization to enhance its response to service disruptions following a significant outage earlier in November.
items.content: Following a major service disruption that occurred between November 12 and 13, Microsoft has declared a 'Code Red' to prioritize the prevention and rapid resolution of future system outages. Internal memos indicate that the company is implementing new measures, including a target to resolve future incidents within one hour. Additional strategies include the deployment of AI agents to assist engineers in diagnosing system health, improved load shedding, and enhanced geographic traffic partitioning. Microsoft leadership has emphasized that these improvements are a top priority to ensure service stability.

items.title: MoneyHero Group Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: MoneyHero Limited has scheduled the release of its third quarter 2026 financial results for December 3, 2026, before the U.S. market opens.
items.content: MoneyHero Limited (NASDAQ: MNY) announced it will report its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Thursday, December 3, 2026, before the U.S. market opens. The company will host a conference call to discuss the results at 8:00 a.m. ET on the same day. Interested parties can access the event via a webcast or audio conference registration link provided by the company. This announcement serves as a scheduling notice for the upcoming earnings release.

items.title: OpenTable to Acquire Hospitality Technology Platform me&u
items.summary: OpenTable, a subsidiary of Booking Holdings, has entered into an agreement to acquire Australian hospitality technology platform me&u to expand its restaurant technology suite.
items.content: OpenTable, a global restaurant technology provider and part of Booking Holdings Inc., has announced an agreement to acquire me&u, an Australian hospitality technology platform. The acquisition aims to integrate me&u's suite of tools—including order and pay, voice AI, guest marketing, and table management—with OpenTable's existing global reservations network. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals, and is expected to be completed in the first half of 2027. Following the acquisition, me&u's employees will join OpenTable, and its current leadership team will continue to manage the business as the two entities operate independently until the deal closes.

items.title: JBDI Holdings Announces Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer and Chairman Appointments
items.summary: JBDI Holdings Limited has appointed Liang Zhao Rong as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman, and Fan Hoi Kit as Chief Financial Officer and executive director, effective November 24, 2026.
items.content: JBDI Holdings Limited announced a leadership transition effective November 24, 2026, with the appointment of Liang Zhao Rong as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board, and Fan Hoi Kit as Chief Financial Officer and an executive director. Mr. Liang, who previously served as the company's Chief Financial Officer and an executive director since October 2022, succeeds Lim Chwee Poh. Mr. Lim is stepping down to focus on family and other business commitments and has confirmed his resignation is not due to any disagreement with the company. Mr. Fan succeeds Mr. Liang as Chief Financial Officer and joins the Board as an executive director. The company noted that Mr. Fan brings experience in international audits, financial reporting assurance, and internal controls to the finance function.

items.title: Jianzhi Education Signs Non-Binding Cross-Border E-Commerce Cooperation Framework Agreement with DIANDIAN EASY PAY
items.summary: Jianzhi Education Technology Group Company Limited has entered into a non-binding framework agreement with DIANDIAN EASY PAY to explore opportunities in AI-enabled cross-border commerce.
items.content: Jianzhi Education has signed a non-binding comprehensive framework agreement with DIANDIAN EASY PAY to collaborate on cross-border e-commerce initiatives. The company aims to leverage this partnership to explore business opportunities in international markets and establish a foundation for long-term cooperation at the intersection of AI technology and digital commerce. The collaboration is subject to further business developments and the terms outlined in the agreement.

items.title: iQIYI Receives Outstanding International Series Award at 2026 Golden Unicorn Awards
items.summary: iQIYI was honored with the 'Outstanding International Series' award at the 2026 Golden Unicorn Awards, which celebrate excellence in short-form and vertical entertainment.
items.content: iQIYI was recognized as the winner of the 'Outstanding International Series' category at the 2026 Golden Unicorn Awards. The awards ceremony, presented by the International Short Drama Association (ISDA), took place in Los Angeles to celebrate production companies, creators, and actors shaping the global short-form and vertical entertainment landscape. The event highlighted the growing influence of vertical storytelling and included industry discussions on the future of the format, revenue sharing, and the role of artificial intelligence in content creation.

items.title: Usage Data Released for MiniMax H3 Video Generation Model
items.summary: AppleToken and GPUtw.ai released performance and usage data for MiniMax's H3 video generation model covering the period from November 4 to November 12, 2026.
items.content: AppleToken, a Japanese AI router, and GPUtw.ai, a Taiwan-based GPU compute center, published usage statistics for MiniMax's H3 video generation model. The data covers a nine-day period from November 4 to November 12, 2026, including an initial open-access window. Following the open period, the model maintained a daily output of over 400 videos, peaking at 832 videos on November 11. Over the full nine-day duration, the model generated 9,738 videos with a reported 98.9% success rate. The report provides insights into the model's performance and user demand following its public availability.

items.title: Ascentage Pharma Announces Trustee Purchase of 100,000 Shares for 2022 RSU Plan
items.summary: Ascentage Pharma reported that its trustee purchased 100,000 existing shares on the market to satisfy restricted share units under its 2022 plan.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, Ascentage Pharma (06855) announced that a trustee purchased a total of 100,000 existing shares on the market. The purchase was conducted to fulfill the requirements of the company's 2022 Restricted Share Unit (RSU) Plan, specifically to satisfy the restricted share units upon their vesting. items.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit alleges that Uber Technologies and Fireworks.AI failed to adequately protect sensitive driver information during an October 2026 data breach.

The complaint claims that an unauthorized third party accessed Uber's systems through compromised Fireworks.AI credentials, exposing information such as driver's license images, names, addresses, and dates of birth. items.title: Juries Award Millions in Separate Johnson & Johnson Talc-Related Mesothelioma Lawsuits
items.summary: Two separate juries in Massachusetts and California awarded millions of dollars in damages in lawsuits alleging that Johnson & Johnson's talc-based baby powder caused mesothelioma.
items.content: On November 24, 2026, juries in Massachusetts and California returned verdicts against Johnson & Johnson in separate mesothelioma cases involving the company's talc-based baby powder. A Suffolk County Superior Court jury in Massachusetts awarded approximately $3.3 million, including court-ordered interest, to the family of a plaintiff who developed mesothelioma after years of product use. Separately, a Northern California jury awarded $34.21 million to a plaintiff who also developed mesothelioma after decades of using the company's talc products. In both instances, jurors determined that the company failed to provide adequate warnings regarding the risk of asbestos contamination in its products, which they found to be a substantial factor in the plaintiffs' diagnoses.
